download_if_not_local <- function(url, dest) {
  dest_path <- file.path("data_raw", dest)
  if (!file.exists(dest_path)) {
    message("Downloading ", dest)
    download.file(url, dest_path, mode = "wb")
  } else {
    message(dest, " already exists, skipping.")
  }
}

replace_nuance <- function(df, nuances_mapping) {
  for (nuance_i in seq_along(nuances_mapping)) {
    for (liste_noms in nuances_mapping[nuance_i]) {
      for (nom in liste_noms) {
        df[df==nom] <- names(nuances_mapping)[nuance_i]
      }
    }
  }
  df
}

#-------------------------------
# Helper function: long table into wide table (proportions)
#
make_wide <- function(df, label) {
  df |>
    dplyr::group_by(bureau, nuance) |>
    dplyr::summarise(votes = sum(votes, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::group_by(bureau) |>
    dplyr::mutate(pct = votes / sum(votes)) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    dplyr::select(bureau, nuance, pct) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = nuance, values_from = pct, values_fill = 0) |>
    dplyr::rename_with(~ paste0(label, "_", .), -bureau) |>
    dplyr::select(where(~ !all(. == 0)))
}

# Ensure all wide tables have the full set of 5 political bloc columns
ensure_nuances <- function(wide_df, prefix) {
  nuances <- c("extreme_gauche", "gauche", "centre", "droite", "extreme_droite")
  expected_cols <- paste0(prefix, "_", nuances)
  for (col in expected_cols) {
    if (!col %in% names(wide_df)) {
      message("Adding missing column: ", col)
      wide_df[[col]] <- 0
    }
  }
  wide_df
}

w_p22r2   <- ensure_nuances(w_p22r2,   "p22r2")

#prepare for cca
to_share_matrix <- function(wide_df) {
  # Remove duplicate bureaux before converting to matrix
  wide_df <- wide_df |> dplyr::distinct(bureau, .keep_all = TRUE)
  mat <- wide_df |>
    dplyr::select(-bureau) |>
    as.matrix()
  rownames(mat) <- wide_df$bureau
  mat
}

# Extract numeric matrix (remove bureau column)
X <- all_elections_clean |>
  dplyr::select(-bureau) |>
  as.matrix()

# ────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Run PCA
# center = TRUE  :  subtract column mean (centering)
# scale. = TRUE  :  divide by SD (scaling)
#                 
pca <- prcomp(X, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

# Check variance explained by each principal component
importance <- summary(pca)$importance
cat("Variance explained by each PC:\n")
print(round(importance[, 1:6] * 100, 1))  #show first 6

# Plot 1: Scree Plot 

variance_df <- data.frame(
  PC       = paste0("PC", 1:length(pca$sdev)),
  variance = (pca$sdev^2) / sum(pca$sdev^2) * 100,  # convert to %
  cumvar   = cumsum((pca$sdev^2) / sum(pca$sdev^2) * 100)  # cumulative
) |> slice(1:6)  #  show first 6

ggplot(variance_df, aes(x = reorder(PC, -variance), y = variance)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#4E79A7", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_line(aes(group = 1), color = "#E15759", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "#E15759", size = 3) +
  geom_line(aes(y = cumvar, group = 1), color = "#76B7B2",
            linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 80, color = "grey50", linetype = "dotted") +
  annotate("text", x = 8, y = 82, label = "80% cumulative variance",
           size = 3, color = "grey50") +
  labs(
    title    = " Scree Plot —Lyon Elections PCA",
    subtitle = "Blue bars = variance per PC | Red = variance | Dashed = cumulative",
    x        = " Principal Component",
    y        = "Variance Explained (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
#meaning of PC1-PC2

#scree_per_election

# Plot 2: Compare PC1 variance explained across elections
# This answers: which election had the most political polarization?
run_pca_single <- function(wide_df, tag) {
  mat <- wide_df |>
    dplyr::select(-bureau) |>
    as.matrix()
  
  pca_res <- prcomp(mat, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
  imp <- summary(pca_res)$importance
  
  list(
    pca    = pca_res,
    bureaux = wide_df$bureau,
    pc1    = round(imp[2, 1] * 100, 1),   # PC1  %
    pc2    = round(imp[2, 2] * 100, 1),   # PC2  %
    tag    = tag
  )
}

pca_eu14    <- run_pca_single(w_eu14,    "EU 2014")
pca_p17r1   <- run_pca_single(w_p17r1,   "Pres 2017 R1")
pca_leg17r1 <- run_pca_single(w_leg17r1, "Leg 2017 R1")
pca_mun20r1 <- run_pca_single(w_mun20r1, "Mun 2020 R1")
pca_p22r1   <- run_pca_single(w_p22r1,   "Pres 2022 R1")

variance_compare <- data.frame(
  election = c("EU 2014", "Pres 2017\nR1", "Leg 2017\nR1",
               "Mun 2020\nR1", "Pres 2022\nR1"),
  pc1 = c(pca_eu14$pc1, pca_p17r1$pc1, pca_leg17r1$pc1,
           pca_mun20r1$pc1, pca_p22r1$pc1),
  pc2 = c(pca_eu14$pc2, pca_p17r1$pc2, pca_leg17r1$pc2,
           pca_mun20r1$pc2, pca_p22r1$pc2)
) |>
  mutate(total = pc1 + pc2,
         election = factor(election, levels = election))

# Convert to long format for stacked bars
variance_long <- variance_compare |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(pc1, pc2),
               names_to = "component",
               values_to = "variance") |>
  mutate(component = ifelse(component == "pc1", "PC1", "PC2"))

ggplot(variance_long, aes(x = election, y = variance, fill = component)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.85, width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(
    data = variance_compare,
    aes(x = election, y = total + 1.5,
        label = paste0(total, "%")),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("PC1" = "#4E79A7", "PC2" = "#A0C4E2"),
                    name = " Component") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 70, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  annotate("text", x = 0.6, y = 71.5,
           label = "70% Reference", size = 3, color = "grey50", hjust = 0) +
  labs(
    title    = " PC1+PC2 Variance Explained per Election",
    subtitle = "Higher = political divide more concentrated on left-right axis",
    x = "", y = " Variance Explained (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

# Plot 3: Correlation circles for all elections (2×3 grid)
# Check if variable directions are consistent across elections

make_circle_data <- function(pca_result, label) {
  as.data.frame(pca_result$pca$rotation[, 1:2]) |>
    rownames_to_column("variable") |>
    mutate(
      election = label,
      length   = sqrt(PC1^2 + PC2^2),
      nuance   = case_when(
        str_detect(variable, "extreme_gauche") ~ "Ext.gauche",
        str_detect(variable, "gauche")         ~ "Gauche",
        str_detect(variable, "centre")         ~ "Centre",
        str_detect(variable, "droite") & !str_detect(variable, "extreme") ~ "Droite",
        str_detect(variable, "extreme_droite") ~ "Ext.droite",
        TRUE ~ "Divers"
      )
    )
}

all_circles <- bind_rows(
  make_circle_data(pca_eu14,    "EU 2014"),

color_palette <- c(
  "Ext.gauche" = "#B22222",
  "Gauche"     = "#E15759",
  "Centre"     = "#F28E2B",

)

circles_comparison <- ggplot(all_circles, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = nuance)) +

  annotate("path",

# ── Biplot───────────────────────────
# 

make_biplot <- function(pca_result, wide_df, title, filename) {

  imp     <- summary(pca_result$pca)$importance
  pc1_pct <- round(imp[2, 1] * 100, 1)
  pc2_pct <- round(imp[2, 2] * 100, 1)

  # Station scores
  scores <- as.data.frame(pca_result$pca$x[, 1:2]) |>
    dplyr::mutate(bureau = pca_result$bureaux)

  #  Scale loadings to match score range
  scale_factor <- max(abs(scores[, 1:2])) /
    max(abs(pca_result$pca$rotation[, 1:2])) * 0.65

  loadings <- as.data.frame(pca_result$pca$rotation[, 1:2]) |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("variable") |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      PC1s   = PC1 * scale_factor,
      PC2s   = PC2 * scale_factor,
      nuance = dplyr::case_when(
        stringr::str_detect(variable, "extreme_gauche") ~ "Ext.gauche",
        stringr::str_detect(variable, "gauche") &
          !stringr::str_detect(variable, "extreme") ~ "Gauche",
        stringr::str_detect(variable, "centre")         ~ "Centre",
        stringr::str_detect(variable, "droite") &
          !stringr::str_detect(variable, "extreme") ~ "Droite",
        stringr::str_detect(variable, "extreme_droite") ~ "Ext.droite",
        TRUE ~ "Divers"
      ),
      length = sqrt(PC1^2 + PC2^2)
    ) |>
    dplyr::group_by(nuance) |>
    dplyr::slice_max(order_by = length, n = 2) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey80", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey80", linetype = "dashed") +
    # Station points (blue dots)
    geom_point(data  = scores,
               aes(x = PC1, y = PC2),
               alpha = 0.3, color = "steelblue", size = 1.8) +
    #  Extreme station labels
    geom_text_repel(
      data = scores |> dplyr::filter(
        abs(PC1) > quantile(abs(PC1), 0.93) |
        abs(PC2) > quantile(abs(PC2), 0.93)
      ),
      aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = bureau),
      size = 2.5, color = "steelblue",
      alpha = 0.8, max.overlaps = 15
    ) +
    # Political nuance arrows
    geom_segment(data = loadings,
                 aes(x = 0, y = 0,
                     xend = PC1s, yend = PC2s,
                     color = nuance),
                 arrow     = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
                 linewidth = 1.1, alpha = 0.9) +
    # Arrow labels
    geom_text_repel(data = loadings,
                    aes(x = PC1s, y = PC2s,
                        label = variable, color = nuance),
                    size = 3.2, fontface = "bold",
                    max.overlaps = 30, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = color_palette, name = "Nuance") +
    labs(
      title    = title,
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Blue dots = polling stations | Arrows = political nuances | ",
        "PC1: ", pc1_pct, "% | PC2: ", pc2_pct, "%"
      ),
      x = paste0("PC1 (", pc1_pct, "%)"),
      y = paste0("PC2 (", pc2_pct, "%)")
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
          legend.position = "right")

  print(p)
 # ggsave(paste0("figures/", filename, ".png"),
 #        plot = p, width = 11, height = 8, dpi = 150)
  #cat(filename, "\n")
}

#  Generate Biplot for each election
make_biplot(pca_eu14,    w_eu14,
            "Biplot — Européennes 2014",        "biplot_eu14")
make_biplot(pca_p17r1,   w_p17r1,
            "Biplot — Présidentielles 2017 T1", "biplot_pres17")
make_biplot(pca_leg17r1, w_leg17r1,
            "Biplot — Législatives 2017 T1",    "biplot_leg17")
make_biplot(pca_mun20r1, w_mun20r1,
            "Biplot — Municipales 2020 T1",     "biplot_mun20")
make_biplot(pca_p22r1,   w_p22r1,
            "Biplot — Présidentielles 2022 T1", "biplot_pres22")

# ============================================================
# CCA
# ============================================================

run_cca <- function(m1, m2, tag1, tag2) {
  
  tag <- paste0(tag1, "_vs_", tag2)
  
  # Step 1: find common stations and align row order
  common_ids <- intersect(rownames(m1), rownames(m2))
  m1 <- m1[match(common_ids, rownames(m1)), , drop = FALSE]
  m2 <- m2[match(common_ids, rownames(m2)), , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(m1) <- common_ids
  rownames(m2) <- common_ids
  message("CCA ", tag, ": ", length(common_ids), " common polling stations")

  # Step 2: drop last column to remove linear dependency (shares sum to 1)
  m1_cca <- m1[, -ncol(m1), drop = FALSE]
  m2_cca <- m2[, -ncol(m2), drop = FALSE]

  # Step 3: filter zero-variance and NA/Inf columns for cancor() only
  keep1 <- apply(m1_cca, 2, function(x)
    !any(is.na(x) | is.nan(x) | is.infinite(x)) && var(x) > 0)
  keep2 <- apply(m2_cca, 2, function(x)
    !any(is.na(x) | is.nan(x) | is.infinite(x)) && var(x) > 0)
  m1_cca <- m1_cca[, keep1, drop = FALSE]
  m2_cca <- m2_cca[, keep2, drop = FALSE]

  message("  m1 valid columns (", ncol(m1_cca), "): ",
          paste(colnames(m1_cca), collapse = ", "))
  message("  m2 valid columns (", ncol(m2_cca), "): ",
          paste(colnames(m2_cca), collapse = ", "))

  # Step 4: skip if either matrix has 0 columns
  if (ncol(m1_cca) == 0 || ncol(m2_cca) == 0) {
    warning("CCA ", tag, " skipped: no valid columns after filtering.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  # Step 5: run CCA
  cca <- stats::cancor(m1_cca, m2_cca)

  # Align coefficient directions for interpretability
  for (d in seq_along(cca$cor)) {
    f <- sign(sum(cca$xcoef[, d] * cca$ycoef[, d]))
    cca$xcoef[, d] <- cca$xcoef[, d] * f
    cca$ycoef[, d] <- cca$ycoef[, d] * f
  }

  # Step 6: compute canonical scores using filtered matrices
  n_can <- min(2, ncol(cca$xcoef), ncol(cca$ycoef))
  U <- m1_cca %*% cca$xcoef[, seq_len(n_can), drop = FALSE]
  V <- m2_cca %*% cca$ycoef[, seq_len(n_can), drop = FALSE]

  # Step 7: correlate full matrices with canonical scores (all blocs shown in plot)
  cor_mat1 <- cor(m1, U)
  colnames(cor_mat1) <- paste0("dim", seq_len(n_can))
  cor_mat2 <- cor(m2, V)
  colnames(cor_mat2) <- paste0("dim", seq_len(n_can))

  # If only one canonical dimension, add dim2 = 0 so ggplot can render
  if (!"dim2" %in% colnames(cor_mat1)) {
    cor_mat1 <- cbind(cor_mat1, dim2 = 0)
    cor_mat2 <- cbind(cor_mat2, dim2 = 0)
  }

  df_plot <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    as.data.frame(cor_mat1) |>
      tibble::rownames_to_column("variable") |>
      dplyr::mutate(election = tag1),
    as.data.frame(cor_mat2) |>
      tibble::rownames_to_column("variable") |>
      dplyr::mutate(election = tag2)
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    nuance_raw = stringr::str_remove(variable, "^[^_]+_"),
    nuance = dplyr::case_when(
      stringr::str_detect(nuance_raw, "extreme_gauche")                      ~ "Ext.gauche",
      stringr::str_detect(nuance_raw, "gauche") &
        !stringr::str_detect(nuance_raw, "extreme")                          ~ "Gauche",
      stringr::str_detect(nuance_raw, "centre")                              ~ "Centre",
      stringr::str_detect(nuance_raw, "droite") &
        !stringr::str_detect(nuance_raw, "extreme")                          ~ "Droite",
      stringr::str_detect(nuance_raw, "extreme_droite")                      ~ "Ext.droite",
      TRUE                                                                   ~ "Divers"
    )
  )

  circle <- tibble::tibble(
    x = cos(seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 300)),
    y = sin(seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 300))
  )

  color_palette <- c(
    "Ext.gauche" = "#B22222", "Gauche" = "#E15759",
    "Centre"     = "#F28E2B", "Droite" = "#4E79A7",
    "Ext.droite" = "#1a1a6e", "Divers" = "#76B7B2"
  )

  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    df_plot, ggplot2::aes(x = dim1, y = dim2, colour = nuance)
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_path(
      data = circle,
      ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y),
      colour = "grey70", inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
    ggplot2::geom_segment(
      ggplot2::aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = dim1, yend = dim2),
      arrow = ggplot2::arrow(length = ggplot2::unit(0.15, "cm")),
      linewidth = 0.8
    ) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      ggplot2::aes(label = variable),
      size = 3.5, fontface = "bold",
      max.overlaps = 20, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ election) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = color_palette, name = "Nuance") +
    ggplot2::coord_fixed(xlim = c(-1.05, 1.05), ylim = c(-1.05, 1.05)) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title    = paste0("CCA — ", tag),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "r1 = ", round(cca$cor[1], 3),
        " | r2 = ", round(cca$cor[2], 3)
      ),
      x = paste0("Canonical dim 1  (r = ", round(cca$cor[1], 3), ")"),
      y = paste0("Canonical dim 2  (r = ", round(cca$cor[2], 3), ")")
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom")

  print(p)

  message("CCA done: ", tag,
          " | r1 = ", round(cca$cor[1], 3),
          " | r2 = ", round(cca$cor[2], 3))

  invisible(list(cca = cca, plot = p, n_stations = length(common_ids)))
}

# ============================================================
# Run CCA
# ============================================================

# Round consistency — municipales only (round 2 retains multiple blocs)
cca_mun20_rounds <- run_cca(sm_mun20r1, sm_mun20r2, "mun20r1", "mun20r2")

# Cross-year comparison (round 1 only)
cca_pres_years   <- run_cca(sm_p17r1,   sm_p22r1,   "p17r1",   "p22r1")
cca_p17_leg17    <- run_cca(sm_p17r1,   sm_leg17r1, "p17r1",   "leg17r1")

# Cross-election type (round 1 only)
cca_eu14_p17r1   <- run_cca(sm_eu14,    sm_p17r1,   "eu14",    "p17r1")
cca_eu14_mun20   <- run_cca(sm_eu14,    sm_mun20r1, "eu14",    "mun20r1")

# Summary table — only include comparisons that were actually run
cca_summary <- tibble::tibble(
  comparison = c(
    "mun20 R1 vs R2",
    "pres 2017 vs 2022",
    "pres 2017 vs leg 2017",
    "eu14 vs pres 2017",
    "eu14 vs mun20"
  ),
  r1 = round(c(
    cca_mun20_rounds$cca$cor[1],
    cca_pres_years$cca$cor[1],
    cca_p17_leg17$cca$cor[1],
    cca_eu14_p17r1$cca$cor[1],
    cca_eu14_mun20$cca$cor[1]
  ), 3),
  n_stations = c(
    cca_mun20_rounds$n_stations,
    cca_pres_years$n_stations,
    cca_p17_leg17$n_stations,
    cca_eu14_p17r1$n_stations,
    cca_eu14_mun20$n_stations
  )
)
print(cca_summary)
